description: Return the public profile of one catalog project, identified by host and either an owner/repo slug or a numeric repository id. host and exactly one of slug or id are required; a call missing them, giving both slug and id, or giving a host other than github or gitlab or a slug that is a URL or ends in a slash is refused as an invalid argument and names what is wrong. A well-formed lookup that matches no project is not an error: it returns {"found": false}. This resolves any project the catalog holds, including one below the discovery floor that search does not return. The profile carries the claim state, verification or generation provenance, the vocabulary dimensions (category, ecosystem, kind, runtime, license_family, topics and capabilities, each present only when it has a value), the five health-signal bands, license and package-registry facets, and staleness. Health signals are reported as bands, not raw measures; no person-derived counts are included. What each band means, and its cut-point, is published on the catalog's methodology page (/methodology). Read-only. Serves catalog schema v1.

id.description: The numeric repository id (the stable identity anchor).
